records.name: SNAP Food Benefits (Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program)
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission (HHSC)
records.description_en: SNAP gives money each month on a Lone Star Card to buy food at grocery stores and other approved stores.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For Texas households with low income. The monthly gross income limit shown by HHSC is $2,152 for 1 person and $4,421 for a family of 4. Bigger families have higher limits.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online at YourTexasBenefits.com, or call 2-1-1 (option 2) for help or a paper application. You can also apply at a local HHS benefits office.
records.notes: HHSC income table: $2,152/month for 1 person, $4,421 for 4, $7,446 for 8, plus $757 for each person over 8 (about 165% FPL; table may update Oct 1 for the new federal fiscal year). Since April 1, 2026 (SB 379), SNAP cannot buy candy or sweetened drinks with 5g+ added sugar or any artificial sweetener. Adults 18-64 without dependents under 14 face a 3-month time limit unless they work/train 80 hrs/month or are exempt. Language/disability help line: (877) 541-7905. Food banks can help people apply. The old apply link now redirects to the YourTexasBenefits.com home page.
records.description_es: SNAP le da dinero cada mes en una tarjeta Lone Star para comprar comida en supermercados y otras tiendas aprobadas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para familias de Texas con ingresos bajos. El límite de ingreso bruto al mes según HHSC es $2,152 para 1 persona y $4,421 para una familia de 4. Las familias más grandes tienen límites más altos.
records.how_to_apply_es: Presente su solicitud en línea en YourTexasBenefits.com, o llame al 2-1-1 (opción 2) para recibir ayuda o una solicitud en papel. También puede ir a una oficina local de beneficios de HHS.

records.name: Texas Simplified Application Project (TSAP) for SNAP
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission (HHSC)
records.description_en: A simpler way for older adults and people with disabilities to get SNAP food benefits, with benefits approved for 3 years at a time.
records.eligibility_summary_en: All household members must be 60 or older or receive disability payments, and no one in the home has job income.
documents_needed: Proof of income (award letters, pension statements)
records.how_to_apply: Apply online at YourTexasBenefits.com, in person at a local HHS office, or call 2-1-1 (option 2) to get an application by mail.
records.notes: Households on SNAP-CAP are not eligible for TSAP. Certification lasts 3 years instead of 6 months, and renewal interviews may be skipped.
records.description_es: Una forma más fácil para que personas mayores y personas con discapacidades reciban SNAP. Los beneficios se aprueban por 3 años a la vez.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Todas las personas del hogar deben tener 60 años o más o recibir pagos por discapacidad, y nadie en el hogar puede tener ingresos de trabajo.
records.how_to_apply_es: Presente su solicitud en línea en YourTexasBenefits.com, en persona en una oficina local de HHS, o llame al 2-1-1 (opción 2) para recibir una solicitud por correo.

records.name: Texas WIC (Women, Infants and Children)
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission - Texas WIC
records.description_en: WIC gives healthy foods, nutrition help, and breastfeeding support to pregnant women, new moms, babies, and children under 5.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For pregnant, breastfeeding, or postpartum women and children under 5 with household income at or below about 185% of poverty (for example $5,088/month for a family of 4). People on Medicaid, SNAP, or TANF already meet the income rule.
documents_needed: Proof of Medicaid, SNAP or TANF (if you have it)
records.how_to_apply: Start online at mywic.us or call (800) 942-3678. Then go to a WIC appointment where staff check eligibility, and get your WIC card if approved.
records.notes: Income table on texaswic.org: $2,461/month for 1 person up to $6,839 for 6 (185% FPL). A pregnant woman's household size counts expected babies. Find offices at https://office.texaswic.org/. 24/7 breastfeeding hotline and the myWIC app available. Online start form: https://mywic.us/participantreferral?program=TX. Who can apply: pregnant women, breastfeeding women, women who had a baby in the last 6 months, and parents/guardians (including fathers) of children under 5.
records.description_es: WIC da alimentos saludables, consejos de nutrición y apoyo para dar pecho a mujeres embarazadas, mamás recientes, bebés y niños menores de 5 años.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para mujeres embarazadas, que dan pecho o que tuvieron un bebé hace poco, y para niños menores de 5 años, con ingresos del hogar de hasta cerca del 185% del nivel de pobreza (por ejemplo, $5,088 al mes para una familia de 4). Si tiene Medicaid, SNAP o TANF, ya cumple con la regla de ingresos.
records.how_to_apply_es: Empiece en línea en mywic.us o llame al (800) 942-3678. Luego vaya a una cita de WIC, donde el personal revisará si califica. Si le aprueban, recibirá su tarjeta WIC.

records.name: National School Lunch Program (free and reduced-price school lunch)
records.organization: Texas Department of Agriculture (TDA), Food and Nutrition Division
records.description_en: Schools serve free or low-cost healthy lunches to children. In Texas, children who qualify for reduced-price meals now eat lunch and breakfast free through the 2026-27 school year.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Children in households at or below 130% of poverty get free meals; up to 185% qualify for reduced-price (now free in Texas for 2025-26 and 2026-27). Children in homes on SNAP or TANF get free meals automatically.
documents_needed: School meal application (household size and income)
SNAP or TANF case number if you have one
records.how_to_apply: Fill out a free and reduced-price meal application from your child's school or school district. Call 877-TEX-MEAL for help.
records.notes: 2026-27 limits (effective July 1, 2026 - June 30, 2027): family of 4 free $42,900/yr, reduced $61,050/yr. Texas Legislature funds free meals for reduced-price-eligible students for SY 2025-26 and 2026-27 (https://squaremeals.org/Programs/National-School-Lunch-Program/Reduced-Price-School-Meals-Now-Free). Some schools serve free meals to all students.
records.description_es: Las escuelas sirven almuerzos saludables gratis o a bajo costo a los niños. En Texas, los niños que califican para comidas a precio reducido ahora comen almuerzo y desayuno gratis hasta el año escolar 2026-27.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Los niños de hogares con ingresos de hasta el 130% del nivel de pobreza reciben comidas gratis; hasta el 185% califican para precio reducido (ahora gratis en Texas en 2025-26 y 2026-27). Los niños de hogares con SNAP o TANF reciben comidas gratis automáticamente.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene una solicitud de comidas gratis o a precio reducido de la escuela o del distrito escolar de su hijo. Llame al 877-TEX-MEAL si necesita ayuda.

records.name: School Breakfast Program
records.organization: Texas Department of Agriculture (TDA), Food and Nutrition Division
records.description_en: Schools serve free or low-cost breakfast to students. Schools with many low-income students must offer free breakfast to all children.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Same income rules as school lunch (130% of poverty free, 185% reduced-price, which is free in Texas through 2026-27).
documents_needed: School meal application (same as school lunch)
records.how_to_apply: Use the same free and reduced-price meal application from your child's school.
records.notes: Texas law requires schools where at least 10% of students are eligible for free or reduced-price meals to take part in the School Breakfast Program; school districts (CEs) with 80% or more free/reduced-price participation in school lunch must serve breakfast at no charge to all children.
records.description_es: Las escuelas sirven desayuno gratis o a bajo costo a los estudiantes. Las escuelas con muchos estudiantes de bajos ingresos deben ofrecer desayuno gratis a todos los niños.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Las mismas reglas de ingresos que el almuerzo escolar (130% del nivel de pobreza para comidas gratis, 185% para precio reducido, que es gratis en Texas hasta 2026-27).
records.how_to_apply_es: Use la misma solicitud de comidas gratis o a precio reducido de la escuela de su hijo.

records.name: Summer Meal Programs (Summer Food Service Program and Seamless Summer Option)
records.organization: Texas Department of Agriculture (TDA), Food and Nutrition Division
records.description_en: Free meals for kids and teens at summer meal sites when school is out. Some rural areas offer grab-and-go or home-delivered meals.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Children and teens 18 and younger, plus eligible people with disabilities, can eat free at open sites.
records.how_to_apply: Find a site on the Summer Meal Site Map, call 877-TEX-MEAL (877-839-6325), or dial 2-1-1. Call the site to confirm dates and times.
records.notes: Summer only (not operating during the school year). Site schedules change, so call ahead. TDA lists a Summer Non-Congregate Feeding Program (grab-and-go/home delivery at approved rural sites). SUN Bucks/Summer EBT participation in Texas could NOT be confirmed; do not promise it.
records.description_es: Comidas gratis para niños y jóvenes en sitios de comidas de verano cuando no hay clases. Algunas zonas rurales ofrecen comidas para llevar o entregadas en casa.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Niños y jóvenes de 18 años o menos, y personas con discapacidades que califiquen, pueden comer gratis en los sitios abiertos.
records.how_to_apply_es: Busque un sitio en el mapa de comidas de verano (Summer Meal Site Map), llame al 877-TEX-MEAL (877-839-6325) o marque 2-1-1. Llame al sitio para confirmar fechas y horarios.

records.name: The Emergency Food Assistance Program (TEFAP)
records.organization: Texas Department of Agriculture (TDA) with Texas food banks
records.description_en: Free USDA groceries and meals given out through food banks, food pantries, and soup kitchens.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Households with total income at or below 185% of the federal poverty guidelines (July 1, 2026 - June 30, 2027 limits).
records.how_to_apply: Contact your local food bank or pantry to find a TEFAP distribution near you, or call 877-TEX-MEAL.
records.notes: Program page: https://squaremeals.org/Programs/The-Emergency-Food-Assistance-Program. Food is given as groceries to take home or as meals eaten on site. TDA's Texas Food Banks page lists which food banks take part in TEFAP. Ask the local pantry what papers it needs.
records.description_es: Comida gratis del USDA que se reparte en bancos de comida, despensas y comedores comunitarios.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para hogares con ingresos totales de hasta el 185% de las guías federales de pobreza (límites del 1 de julio de 2026 al 30 de junio de 2027).
records.how_to_apply_es: Comuníquese con su banco de comida o despensa local para encontrar una entrega de TEFAP cerca de usted, o llame al 877-TEX-MEAL.

records.name: Commodity Supplemental Food Program (CSFP) Senior Food Boxes
records.organization: Texas Department of Agriculture (TDA) with Texas food banks
records.description_en: A free monthly box of healthy USDA foods for older adults, plus nutrition education.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Adults 60 and older with household income at or below 130% of the federal poverty guidelines.
records.how_to_apply: Contact your local food bank to sign up for a monthly senior box. Call 877-TEX-MEAL for help.
records.notes: 130% FPL limit confirmed on the TDA Income Eligibility Guidelines page. TDA runs CSFP through food banks, which work with local groups to hand out boxes; waiting lists may exist. TDA's food bank list (checked 2026-09-26) does not mark CSFP for Coastal Bend, West Central Texas, or Wichita Falls Area food banks.
records.description_es: Una caja gratis de alimentos saludables del USDA cada mes para personas mayores, además de consejos de nutrición.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Adultos de 60 años o más con ingresos del hogar de hasta el 130% de las guías federales de pobreza.
records.how_to_apply_es: Comuníquese con su banco de comida local para inscribirse y recibir una caja cada mes. Llame al 877-TEX-MEAL si necesita ayuda.

records.name: Senior Farmers' Market Nutrition Program (SFMNP)
records.description_en: Vouchers older adults can use to buy fresh fruits, vegetables, and herbs from local farmers' markets.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Adults 60 and older with household income at or below 185% of the federal poverty guidelines, in participating areas only.
records.how_to_apply: Call 877-TEX-MEAL to find out if the program is offered in your area and who hands out vouchers.
records.notes: Not a statewide program; participating counties not listed on the page. Seasonal. Voucher amount not stated on source. 185% limit from TDA income guidelines page.
records.description_es: Cupones para que personas mayores compren frutas, verduras y hierbas frescas en mercados de agricultores locales.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Adultos de 60 años o más con ingresos del hogar de hasta el 185% de las guías federales de pobreza, solo en las zonas que participan.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 877-TEX-MEAL para saber si el programa se ofrece en su zona y quién reparte los cupones.

records.name: Farmers' Market Nutrition Program (FMNP)
records.description_en: Vouchers for low-income women and children to buy fresh fruits and vegetables at participating farmers' markets.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For low-income women and children in participating areas only.
records.how_to_apply: Ask your WIC clinic or call 877-TEX-MEAL to see if vouchers are available in your area.
records.notes: Not a statewide program; participating areas not listed on source. Benefit amount and season not stated.
records.description_es: Cupones para mujeres y niños de bajos ingresos para comprar frutas y verduras frescas en mercados de agricultores que participan.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para mujeres y niños de bajos ingresos, solo en las zonas que participan.
records.how_to_apply_es: Pregunte en su clínica de WIC o llame al 877-TEX-MEAL para saber si hay cupones en su zona.

records.name: Texas SNAP-Ed Nutrition Education
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission (HHSC) and partner providers
records.description_en: Free classes on food budgeting, food safety, healthy eating, and staying active.
records.eligibility_summary_en: For people who get or may qualify for SNAP; check with a local provider.
records.how_to_apply: See the HHSC SNAP-Ed page for the list of providers (such as Texas A&M AgriLife Extension, Brighter Bites, Feeding Texas) and contact one near you.
records.notes: Education only; does not give food benefits.
records.description_es: Clases gratis sobre cómo hacer rendir el dinero para la comida, cómo manejar los alimentos de forma segura, comer sano y mantenerse activo.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que reciben SNAP o que podrían calificar. Pregunte a un proveedor local.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vea la página de SNAP-Ed de HHSC para ver la lista de proveedores (como Texas A&M AgriLife Extension, Brighter Bites y Feeding Texas) y comuníquese con uno cerca de usted.

records.name: Feeding Texas - Find My Food Bank
records.description_en: Statewide network of 20 food banks. Its website finds your local food bank by ZIP code or county.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Anyone in Texas who needs food can use the finder; local pantries set their own rules.
records.how_to_apply: Enter your ZIP code or county at feedingtexas.org/food-banks to find your food bank, then use its 'Find Food' tool.
records.notes: Phone is the Feeding Texas office, not a food hotline. The finder lists 20 member food banks. Food banks also help people apply for SNAP and other benefits.
records.description_es: Red estatal de 20 bancos de comida. Su sitio web le ayuda a encontrar su banco de comida local por código postal o condado.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier persona en Texas que necesite comida puede usar el buscador. Cada despensa local pone sus propias reglas.
records.how_to_apply_es: Escriba su código postal o condado en feedingtexas.org/food-banks para encontrar su banco de comida. Luego use su herramienta 'Find Food' (Buscar comida).

records.name: Area Agencies on Aging (meals and services for older adults)
records.organization: Texas Health and Human Services Commission (HHSC)
records.description_en: Local Area Agencies on Aging connect older Texans to services, such as meals delivered at home or meals at senior centers.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Mainly for older adults and their caregivers.
records.how_to_apply: Call 800-252-9240 to reach your local Area Agency on Aging, or 855-YES-ADRC (855-937-2372) for Aging and Disability Resource Centers.
records.notes: Phone numbers confirmed on the HHSC aging page. ADRC line: (855) 937-2372. The source page does not describe meal services; AAAs commonly fund local home-delivered and senior-center meal programs, so confirm what is offered locally.
records.description_es: Las Agencias del Área para Personas Mayores (Area Agencies on Aging) conectan a las personas mayores de Texas con servicios, como comidas entregadas en casa o comidas en centros para personas mayores.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Principalmente para personas mayores y quienes las cuidan.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al 800-252-9240 para comunicarse con su Agencia del Área para Personas Mayores, o al 855-YES-ADRC (855-937-2372) para los Centros de Recursos para Personas Mayores y con Discapacidades (ADRC).

records.name: Meals on Wheels Texas - Find Your Local Provider
records.description_en: Statewide association of Meals on Wheels programs. Its search tool finds home-delivered and senior-center meal programs by ZIP code.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Local programs mostly serve homebound seniors and adults with disabilities; rules vary by provider.
records.how_to_apply: Search by ZIP code at mealsonwheelstexas.org/search-mow. If nothing shows up, try nearby ZIP codes or call 2-1-1.
records.notes: Phone is the association office (844-4TX-MEAL), for association business, not meal requests. Directory lists about 350 local providers; confirm details with the provider.
records.description_es: Asociación estatal de programas de Meals on Wheels. Su buscador encuentra programas de comidas a domicilio y en centros para personas mayores por código postal.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Los programas locales atienden sobre todo a personas mayores que no pueden salir de casa y a adultos con discapacidades. Las reglas cambian según el proveedor.
records.how_to_apply_es: Busque por código postal en mealsonwheelstexas.org/search-mow. Si no aparece nada, pruebe con códigos postales cercanos o llame al 2-1-1.

records.name: Brazos Valley Food Bank
records.description_en: Brazos Valley Food Bank gives out free food through partner food pantries, meal sites, and mobile food distributions, and can help you apply for SNAP.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People in its service counties who need food. Each pantry may have its own rules; some federal programs (TEFAP, CSFP) have income limits.
records.how_to_apply: Use the 'Find Food' tool on the food bank's website or call the food bank to find a pantry or distribution near you.
records.notes: Feeding Texas member food bank. Supplies local food pantries, meal programs, and mobile distributions in its counties; food banks distribute TEFAP and CSFP senior boxes and help with SNAP applications. HHSC Texas Food Bank Network lists SNAP application help at (979) 779-3663 ext. 105. Address, phone, and counties confirmed on the Feeding Texas food bank directory (2026-09-26).
records.description_es: Brazos Valley Food Bank reparte comida gratis por medio de despensas, comedores y entregas móviles de comida. También le puede ayudar a pedir SNAP.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que necesitan comida en los condados que atiende. Cada despensa puede tener sus propias reglas. Algunos programas federales (TEFAP, CSFP) tienen límites de ingresos.
records.how_to_apply_es: Use la herramienta 'Find Food' (Buscar comida) en el sitio web del banco de comida, o llame al banco de comida para encontrar una despensa o entrega de comida cerca de usted.
